meta.move: END MEETING as the very first turn, then repeats
meta.expect: Index 0 ends immediately: email plus four-line debrief (debrief should be honest that little happened). After that, one closing line per message; second END MEETING does not regenerate a debrief; 'resume' does not restart.

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me first, so who decided that, and when?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that Owen's zero be withdrawn, that I receive an apology, and that you tell me who decided on the zero and when. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position with nothing agreed; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and an answer on who decided it and when, and she is still headed to the principal. That is not the fair outcome, which would be a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, but the meeting ended before you spoke, not because her time ran out.
What moved her: Nothing, because the meeting ended before you said anything she could weigh.
What cost ground: Nothing, since you made no move that could cost you.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; no evidence was shown, so nothing came near that night; it proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fights so hard.
Try next time: When she opens by asking who decided the zero and why nobody called her, answer in one sentence that entering it before contacting her broke procedure 4.2, then put a dated document tied to Owen's own work in front of her.
The meeting is over. To practise again, start a new chat and paste the first message from the README.
